{{Short description|French chemist (1920–2005)}}
{{Expand French|topic=bio|Jacques-Émile Dubois|date=January 2012}}
'''Jacques-Émile Dubois''' (13 April 1920 – 2 April 2005) was a French chemist.

In 1981, Dubois became a founding member of the [[World Cultural Council]].<ref>{{cite web | title = About Us | publisher = [[World Cultural Council]] | url = http://www.consejoculturalmundial.org/about-us/ | access-date = November 8, 2016}}</ref>
